# Saarkesh — Saark Creates

> Saarkesh is a software engineer and full-stack developer based in Colombo, Sri Lanka. Software is his main work; he also does video editing and graphic design. He builds websites, web apps and online stores with React, Next.js, Laravel and Node.js, and handles hosting and deployment end to end. He is open to Software Engineer roles (including internships) and freelance projects.

Contact: cheerysaark@gmail.com · WhatsApp +94 70 377 1851 · GitHub https://github.com/cheerysaaru · Location: Colombo, Sri Lanka (works remotely worldwide)

## Web development services
- Business and company websites
- Custom web apps (user accounts, dashboards, portals, quotation tools)
- E-commerce and WhatsApp ordering websites
- REST APIs and back ends (Laravel, Node.js)
- Hosting, domain, DNS, SSL, Cloudflare and Linux server deployment
- Website redesign and SEO

## Selected projects
- [Synnex Technology](https://synnex-technology.com): React + Vite website with a Laravel 11 API, user accounts, enquiries, admin dashboard; English/Tamil/Sinhala
- [CheeryHub](https://cheeryhub.space): full-stack productivity PWA with Node.js, Prisma and web push
- [Vallunar Groups](https://vallunar.com): corporate website in Next.js, TypeScript and Tailwind
- [BiteMe Food & Products](https://bitemefoods.site): restaurant and e-commerce site with cart and WhatsApp checkout
- Synnex quotation system: private Node.js internal tool (PM2, LiteSpeed)
